description: This file is a Go source file containing test-related code for the 'instancemanager' component within the 'orchestrator' package. It defines a validator, a helper function to execute commands with a context, and a function to create a build source configuration for Android Continuous Integration, utilizing external API structures.

classes.name: AlwaysSucceedsValidator
classes.description: A validator struct that always succeeds when its Validate method is called.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Method of AlwaysSucceedsValidator that always returns nil, indicating success.

methods.name: execCtxAlwaysSucceeds
methods.description: Creates an exec.Cmd that executes 'true' regardless of context or parameters, simulating a successful command execution.

methods.name: androidCISource
methods.description: Constructs and returns a BuildSource object configured with provided build ID and target, representing an Android CI build source.
